name: dinner_money_debt
description: A letter to a family whose school meal account is overdrawn.
subject: School meals account - {pupil_name}
body: {pupil_name}'s school meals account is overdrawn by {debt}.

Please top up the account at the school office or online as soon as you can. {pupil_name} will not be refused a meal. If paying is difficult, please contact the office in confidence - your child may be entitled to free school meals, and we can help you apply.

placeholders.sender_name: The member of staff sending it
